_readme: Copy this into YOUR PROJECT directory, never into the skill directory.
This file is non-secret: it holds routing, not credentials.
The token lives only in the environment as TIKTOK_ACCESS_TOKEN.
currency and timezone must match the ad account exactly - both are permanent
on TikTok and every budget bound and daily number derives from them.
ttops doctor checks them against /advertiser/info/ and refuses on a mismatch.

main.notes: GEO: US. Vertical: e-commerce. Access level: ad-account Admin.
